newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed ahead of USDA report.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed ahead of USDA report.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Wednesday as local investors were reluctant to trade ahead of the USDA's crop report, which will be released this Friday.
Prices ranged from 60 yen lower to 140 yen higher, and the benchmark January 1998 contract was down 60 yen at 14,290 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 35,273 lots.

The market lacked clear direction on Wednesday as many investors were sidelined ahead of the USDA's crop report, traders said. "Light short-covering by some investors supported nearby months. But the market was basically quiet today," a brokerage house trader said.
As of 0745 GMT, the spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A system was last traded at $2.58-1/4 per bushel, unchanged from Monday's Chicago close.
Spot January CBOT soybean futures on Project A were at $6.96-1/4, down from $6.98-1/2.
